assessments.reasoning: Sections 1.4, 1.6 and 1.13 identify the covered material and distinguish its forms. Section 3.2 supplies the distribution trigger and incorporates section 3.1, which governs the source terms, license information and recipient rights. All six cited publisher ranges match.

limitations: The obligation concerns the Covered Software in its preferred form for modification. The clause gives no fixed delivery deadline or monetary ceiling independent of distribution cost.
reasoning: Distribution of Covered Software in Executable Form triggers two duties under section 3.2(a). The distributor must make the covered source available under section 3.1 and tell executable recipients how to obtain it. The method must be reasonable, delivery timely and the charge within the cost of distribution to the recipient.
